seoTitle: How to Integrate Shopify with Odoo ERP (2026)
metaDescription: Connect Shopify to Odoo ERP using a connector module to sync products, inventory, and orders and eliminate manual data entry.
intro: Running Shopify alongside a separate ERP system often means duplicate data entry, unless the two are properly connected. This guide covers installing an Odoo connector module, generating Shopify API credentials, and configuring bidirectional sync so your products, orders, and inventory stay aligned across both platforms.

steps.heading: Install the connector module
steps.body: Add the Odoo Shopify connector app to your Odoo instance.

steps.heading: Generate Shopify API credentials
steps.body: Create API access tokens in Shopify so Odoo can securely connect to your store.

steps.heading: Connect your store instance
steps.body: Link your Shopify store to Odoo using the generated credentials.

steps.heading: Map products and variants
steps.body: Match products and variants between both platforms using SKUs to keep listings aligned.

steps.heading: Configure inventory sync
steps.body: Set up real-time inventory synchronization so stock levels stay accurate on both systems.

steps.heading: Test order automation
steps.body: Verify that order automation and invoicing workflows run correctly with a test transaction.

faq.question: Does this integration sync inventory in real time?
faq.answer: Yes, the setup includes configuring real-time inventory synchronization between Shopify and Odoo.

faq.question: How are products matched between the two platforms?
faq.answer: Products and variants are mapped using SKUs, which helps keep listings consistent across Shopify and Odoo.

faq.question: Can this automate invoicing as well as inventory?
faq.answer: Yes, the connector is designed to support automated workflows for both invoicing and stock updates.

faq.question: Do I need a Shopify API key to set this up?
faq.answer: Yes, generating Shopify API credentials is a required step for securely connecting your store to the Odoo connector.
